turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
A quick reminder: this lesson is about things we did last weekend. Those things are finished.
I will do one step by step. Step 1: the verb is visit. Step 2: the action is finished, so I add -ed. Step 3: Last weekend I visited my aunt.
The rule: for most verbs, add -ed when you talk about a finished action.
Right: We cooked rice yesterday. Wrong: We cook rice yesterday.
Your turn. Write the past of "wash":
Yesterday she ___ her car.
